elements.element: Audit frequency limited to no more than once per 12 months
elements.evidence: "conducted no more than once in any twelve (12) month period"

elements.element: At least 30 days' prior written notice
elements.evidence: "upon no less than thirty (30) days prior written notice to the Company"

elements.element: Audit conducted by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality
elements.evidence: "by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality"

elements.element: Vendor bears audit cost (unless underpayment exceeds 5%)
elements.evidence: "The fees incurred by HDI in connection with the inspection shall be borne by HDI." — unconditional vendor-cost, at least as favourable as the 5% carve-out

elements.element: No direct access to Customer systems
elements.evidence: "shall not include any direct access to the Company's systems"

elements.element: Audit no more than once per year
elements.evidence: "no more than once in any twelve (12) month period"
"thirty (30) days prior written notice" exceeds 15 days

elements.element: Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds 10%
elements.evidence: "fees incurred by HDI ... shall be borne by HDI"

reasons: The single inserted sentence supplies the three absent preferred elements (annual frequency cap, independent confidentiality-bound auditor, no direct system access); notice, business hours and vendor-borne cost were already present.
The unconditional "borne by HDI" cost allocation is more favourable to Customer than the preferred 5% carve-out, so no change was needed there.
Insertion is concise, introduces no undefined terms, and leaves the existing inspection scope and all untouched sentences fully effective.
